Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You gather yourself low and spring with a hunter’s sudden certainty.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
One creature reachable by a legal move of up to 2 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Claws or a fleeting beast-shape carry you into the leap. Move up to 2 squares, then strike an adjacent target; no prior transformation is required. Movement provokes normally.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
4 physical damage and knock prone.
Strong
6 physical damage and knock prone; move 1 square without provoking afterward.
